sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Legal Accounting Defense for International Anti-Dumping Inquiries

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–Germany Bilateral Investment and Protection Treaty

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 23 of 2015, as amended by Law 70 of 2019; Executive Decree No. 158 of 2020 (Beneficial Ownership Register); Agreement No. 1 of 2016 of the SSNF (Superintendency of Non-Financial Subjects); Consolidated Criminal Code Arts. 254-255.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the valid passport or identity card of each ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport office or notary public in the country of issuance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for Apostille member states; alternatively consular legalization for non-Apostille jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or certified copy of proof of residential address (public utility bill, bank statement, or municipal registration)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, licensed bank, or municipal authority in the country of UBO residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or creditworthiness certificate issued within the last 30 days
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank in the UBO's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Incumbency (if UBO is a corporate entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official companies registrar of the entity's country of incorporation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Panama's national sanctions list maintained by the SSNF. Enhanced due diligence is required for Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) as defined by Law 23 of 2015, including their family members and close associates. The screening must be documented and retained for at least five years; any flagged positive hit triggers immediate filing of a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) with the SSNF.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Online Name Reservation System (Servicios en Línea – Reserva de Nombre), www.registropublico.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish, English, or another language using the Latin alphabet. The name must include the suffix 'Sociedad Anónima' or 'S.A.' Non-Latin script names must be notarially transliterated into Spanish prior to registration. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registration in the same class.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within five (5) business days of a rejection notice, the applicant may file a written appeal (recurso de apelación) with the General Directorate of the Registro Público, citing the legal grounds and attaching evidence of prior trademark rights or usage. The Registry must respond within ten (10) business days. If the appeal is denied, a reconsideration request may be filed within three (3) business days, followed by a judicial appeal before the Administrative Contentious Chamber of the Supreme Court of Justice within two (2) months. The name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30-day period upon payment of the prescribed extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible for the company's operational headquarters, but the registered agent must maintain a physical Panamanian address for legal service of process. For the trade-defense consulting sector, no dedicated physical office is required by statute; however, the company should ensure adequate data communication infrastructure and retain the registered agent's address as the official registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 12-15% annual probability for a standard non-regulated consulting S.A.; risk increases to 30-35% if the company triggers a DGI tax audit, engages in regulated accounting services, or is involved in government-related trade remedy proceedings. Unannounced on-site inspections are not routine but may occur under general AML supervision by the SSNF.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and registration fee at the Public Registry (incl. single registration of corporate name)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Public Registry fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting, legal review, and notarization of articles of incorporation (Escritura Pública) for a Sociedad Anónima
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panama law firm and Notary Public
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Panama Bar Association prevailing fixed and hourly rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory AML/CFT due diligence package (UBO identification, PEP and sanctions screening, risk matrix, and beneficial ownership register preliminary analysis)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed compliance service provider or SSNF-registered law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed fee benchmark per UBO; incremental charge for additional UBOs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization of UBO identity and address documents (per document set)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Panama (Apostille Section) and notary public
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Apostille fee of $50 per document, notarial fee, and international courier

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office service for the first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed law firm acting as resident agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Annual maintenance tariff, prevailing market benchmark $850–$1,200

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Tax registration (RUC) and municipal operation notice (Aviso de Operación)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) and Municipality of Panama
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration fee and municipal license tariff

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades (Law No. 32 of 26 February 1927, as amended by Law 19 of 2017), Articles 3, 5, 6, 8 and 57 governing the incorporation deed, share subscription, registered office and officer appointments; supplemented by the Regulations of the Public Registry of Panama.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil (Mercantile Section, Public Registry of Panama)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima (Notarized Articles of Incorporation registered as the Certificate of Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required; the articles customarily authorize US$10,000.00 divided into 10,000 common shares of US$1.00 par value, of which at least one share must be subscribed and issued. No escrow account or bank deposit is required by law at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, FIRST: The subscription schedule in the Company's authorized capital of US$10,000.00, divided into 10,000 common shares of US$1.00 par value each, is ratified, and the founding subscriber's subscription of 100 registered shares is accepted and duly credited. RESOLVED, SECOND: The registered office of the Company is fixed at the law office of the Resident Agent in Panama, and the resident agency agreement is ratified. RESOLVED, THIRD: The subscriber is appointed President, Secretary, and Treasurer for one-year terms; the President and Treasurer are constituted joint legal representatives with power to execute contracts, open bank accounts, and file registry filings. RESOLVED, FOURTH: No directors' compensation shall be paid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Oficina de Nombres (online via Registro Público en Línea portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct an online search of the corporate name database and submit the Solicitud de Reserva de Nombre with up to three proposed names. The Registry verifies uniqueness and issues a name reservation certificate valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form (Solicitud de Reserva de Nombre)
Copy of subscriber's passport
Payment receipt for name search and stamp fees
Notarized power of attorney if filed through local counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as confusingly similar, re-file immediately with alternative proposed names; no formal appeal is necessary before re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarized Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública (Public Notary) in Panama City
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima in Spanish and execute it before the notary by the founding shareholders, who must subscribe at least one share of the authorized capital. The notary authenticates signature pages and records the deed in the notarial protocol.
required_dossiers: Corporate name reservation certificate
Passport copies of all subscribing shareholders
Draft articles of incorporation prepared by counsel
Resident agent acceptance letter executed by the designated authorized attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requires corrections, revise and re-execute the deed; minor defects may be cured by a notarial addendum (otra escritura de rectificación) executed before the same notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Corporation with the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil, Presentation Window (Ventanilla)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the protocolized deed together with the registry cover sheet at the Mercantil Section presentation window; pay the statutory stamp duty and registry tariff through Banco Nacional de Panamá; the Registry enters the company in the corporate register and stamps the deed as 'Inscrita'.
required_dossiers: Original notarized deed (Escritura Pública de Constitución)
Registry filing cover sheet (hoja de presentación)
Deposit receipt for registry fees and stamp duties from Banco Nacional de Panamá
Name reservation certificate
Digital PDF copy of the executed deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues an observation (observación), counsel files a brief of subsanación within 30 days; corrected pages are re-filed and registration proceeds once the observation is cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Resident Agent Appointment and Registered Office Establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantil Section; Resident Agent must be an Abogado Idóneo authorized by the Corte Suprema de Justicia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The first board resolution accepts the resident agency agreement and fixes the registered office (domicilio legal) at the resident agent's licensed law office. The executed agreement and the board resolution are recorded in the statutory corporate records book and, where applicable, appended to the registry file.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma first board resolution
Resident agency agreement executed by the authorized attorney
Professional license (idoneidad) and identity card of the resident agent
Registry certificate of incorporation of the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A change of resident agent is effected by filing an Aviso de Traspaso with the Public Registry within the statutory deadline, executed by the newly appointed authorized attorney.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, Virtual Tax Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) application using the certificate of incorporation issued by the Public Registry; provide the legal representative's identification and registered office details; receive the RUC card and territorial-scope tax registration number for invoicing and customs operations.
required_dossiers: Literal certificate of incorporation (Copia Literal) issued by the Public Registry
RUC registration application form
Passport or identity card of the legal representative
Proof of registered office address
Notarized certificate of officer appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI requires clarifications, correct the application data and re-file through the agent's virtual window within 10 working days; no re-notarization is required unless officer details change.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operation Notice and Physical Premises Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía de Panamá – Departamento de Avisos de Operación; Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Aviso de Operación at the Municipality of Panama based on the RUC and registry certificate; obtain the fire safety certificate for the office premises; file the Category I environmental registration with MiAMBIENTE for low-impact office consulting activity. No industrial manufacturing concession applies to ISIC 7490 services.
required_dossiers: RUC certificate
Certificate of incorporation from the Public Registry
Lease deed or ownership title for the office premises
Fire safety inspection application
MiAMBIENTE Category I environmental registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality rejects the notice, correct the stated economic activity code (ISIC 7490) and re-file; fire inspection can be rescheduled once the structural and evacuation plan is brought into compliance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) – Dirección Nacional de Regulación; Alcaldía de Panamá – Departamento de Avisos de Operación
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (Municipal Operation Notice) issued under Law 6 of 2016; no manufacturing or industrial operating concession is required for ISIC 7490 trade remedy defense consulting services

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Normas y Evaluación Ambiental de Impacto
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I – Registro Ambiental (low-impact office use); full Estudio de Impacto Ambiental is not required for professional anti-dumping trade defense consulting
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero process wastewater discharge; sanitary sewage only through the municipal collection network; no VOC or combustion air emissions from industrial sources; office solid waste and electronic waste segregated and handled pursuant to Law 6 of 2016 and the national solid waste regulations, with applicable air quality compliance for small stationary office equipment

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (Certificado de Seguridad y Prevención de Incendios) issued by the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá following on-site inspection; structural load and occupancy inspection of the office premises; workplace hygiene and safety clearance from the Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) covering occupational risk prevention and emergency evacuation compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) – Sede Electrónica e-Tax portal (https://sede.electronica.gob.pa)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity appoints a licensed Panamanian attorney or resident agent, who files the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) application through the DGI Sede Electrónica e-Tax system. Required attachments include certified charter and bylaws, legalization documents (apostille), identification of directors and officers, a local registered office address, and appointment of a fiscal representative. RUC is issued within approximately 15 business days; the taxpayer must then register for ITBMS and, if applicable, the small-taxpayer simplified regime.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election is recognized in Panamanian domestic law. Available elections include: (i) consolidated group tax filing during an approved corporate reorganization; (ii) special Multinational Headquarters (SEM) regime election; (iii) small-taxpayer cash-basis regime election for annual turnover ≤ B/. 300,000; and (iv) one-time measures for transfer pricing adjustments or accelerated depreciation as permitted by the Tax Code.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto a la Transferencia de Bienes Corporales Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS) – a VAT-style transfer tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis registration threshold; ITBMS registration is mandatory upon the commencement of taxable sales or services in Panama. An optional simplified small-taxpayer regime applies to taxpayers with annual turnover up to B/. 300,000 (Balboa at parity with USD).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates phased electronic invoicing via the DGI e-Tax platform under Resolution No. 066-2022. Taxpayers must obtain an Electronic Invoicing Authorization (CFE) and transmit invoice XML data to the DGI in real or near-real time through approved API/WebService integrators or the free DGI facturador. Each fiscal invoice must carry the CFE stamp and a secure access code; temporary and definitive implementation phases are based on taxpayer size and sector.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods that leave Panama through a customs exit, and certain internationally oriented services (including consulting, legal, and trade-remedy-defense services provided entirely to non-resident counterparties for use outside Panama), qualify for a 0% ITBMS rate. The zero rating is allowed only if the taxpayer retains documentary proof of departure or of an offshore supply, and if services are not economically consumed within Panamanian territory.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Although Panama’s free-market foreign-exchange regime does not impose a statutory repatriation deadline, the 180-day benchmark is applied by tax authorities as an evidentiary standard for inward remittance documentation. False or unsupported export zero-rating triggers retroactive ITBMS settlement at 7% plus monthly interest (5%), fines from 50% to 100% of the omitted tax, and criminal tax-fraud penalties of up to five years’ imprisonment under Articles 708 and 711 of the Panamanian Fiscal Code.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No central bank exists. The Superintendencia de Bancos de Panama (SBP) is the exclusive banking and AML/CFT supervisor; Banco Nacional de Panama (state-owned) acts as fiscal agent, domestic clearing and settlement operator of SIPA/SICA, and custodian of public deposits; the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the Direccion General de Ingresos administer fiscal and tax controls. Monetary policy is fixed by statute: the US dollar is legal tender and the balboa (PAB) is a non-issued accounting unit pegged 1:1 to USD (Currency Law of 1904).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full dollarization means absolute convertibility on both current and capital account. There are no exchange controls, no central-bank authorization for inward remittances, no capital-account declaration, and no restrictions on dividend, profit or capital repatriation to non-resident shareholders. Because the entity applies Panama's territorial tax principle (Codigo Fiscal), income from legal and accounting anti-dumping defense services rendered to foreign exporters is extraterritorial-source, not taxable in Panama, and may be freely distributed abroad. Residual friction exists only at bank level through source-of-funds verification and OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama does not require surrender, repatriation timelines, or conversion ratios for goods or services export proceeds. Service fees for the anti-dumping defense consultancy may be held indefinitely in USD in Panama or offshore. Only monitoring obligations apply: SBP AML/CFT suspicious-transaction reporting (Law 23 of 2015; Acuerdo 05-2015 as amended) and physical-cash customs declarations over USD 10,000 under cash-in-transit rules.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (primary USD treasury, SWIFT/nostro via New York correspondents)
Operational Account with trade-finance and MT103/MT700 desk
Capital Escrow Account (state fiscal agent; institutional relationship)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Franchise Tax and Registry Renewal (Pago de Impuesto Anual de Sociedades)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), collected through the Registro Público de Panamá
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before June 30 of each calendar year; an additional grace month applies only after payment of the relevant surcharge.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge of USD 25 for the first overdue month and USD 20 for each subsequent month; when unpaid for more than nine months, the registry records an administrative strike-off and reactivation requires payment of all overdue fees plus a USD 180 reinstatement charge.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return for Panama-Source and Foreign-Source Territorial Income (Form 2010)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year taxpayers, due by March 31 of the year immediately following the taxable year; installment payment plans require submission of a sixth-month advance declaration.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines ranging from USD 50 to 100% of the omitted tax; interest accrues at the rate set in the Panamanian tax code (usually the bank prime rate plus 12%); intentional omission with false statements can impose criminal tax penalties and directors’ liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and Renewal for the Registro Único de Beneficiario Final (RUBF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – RUBF Directorate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual payment and confirmation must be completed no later than March 31 following the close of the calendar year; any transfer of a 10% or greater ownership interest must be updated within 30 days of the transfer.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unfiled or incomplete RUBF confirmation is subject to a fine of up to PAN 5,000; the registered agent is separately liable for sanctions; repeated non-compliance can suspend the legal title of the corporation and preclude the issuance of certificate of good standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML / KYC Client File Update and Registered Agent Certification (diligencia anual)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) and Superintendencia General de Sociedades (SGS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual review of the beneficial ownership, risk profile, and source of funds must be updated on or before December 31; certified copies of the complete file must be delivered to UAF within 10 business days of an official request.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines of USD 3,000 to USD 10,000 for failure to maintain current AML files; a second serious violation permits SGS to order the suspension or dissolution of the corporation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A private Panamanian S.A. is not automatically required to have an independent audit. A statutory audit is compulsory for: (1) regulated financial institutions licensed by the Superintendencia General de Banca or the Superintendencia de Seguros y Reaseguros de Panamá; (2) issuers and reporting companies under the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores; (3) large taxpayers designated as Grandes Contribuyentes by the DGI; and (4) any entity contractually required to furnish audited financial statements to a third party, such as an international bank financing arrangement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Public interest and regulated entities must prepare financial statements under IFRS as issued by the IASB; other corporations may use the approved Normas de Contabilidad de Panamá (Panamanian GAAP) or IFRS once consistently adopted.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A Panamanian S.A. must, through its registered agent, file at least one annual confirmation with the RUBF showing each ultimate beneficial owner's name, address, nationality, proportion of economic interest, and control mechanism. The confirmation must also be updated within 30 days of any share transfer representing 10% or more of the capital, or whenever a new director or beneficial owner is appointed. The registered agent must keep a notarized copy of the confirmation at the registered office and present it to the UAF upon inspection.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Share Transfer Ledger (Libro de Registro de Transferencia de Acciones)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 - USD 1,500 per annum for licensed registered agent and registered office services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,800 - USD 12,000 per engagement depending on asset complexity and activity volume

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% on Panama-source taxable profits of a Sociedad Anónima (S.A.); foreign-source income is excluded under Panama's territorial taxation principle (Código Fiscal, Article 694), provided the anti-dumping trade defense consulting services are performed and economically managed from outside Panamanian territory.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday for a standard S.A.; preferential regimes available: (i) 5% effective rate under the Multinational Company Headquarters (SEM) regime for qualified cross-border service hubs; (ii) 0% income tax on licensed activities in the Panama Pacifico Special Economic Area; (iii) territorial exclusions for fees earned abroad; (iv) standard deductions for payroll, rent, and professional fees directly attributable to Panama-source revenue; (v) no tax on capital gains from sale of shares when underlying assets are foreign.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 202 (Declaración Anual de Renta de Personas Jurídicas), filed electronically through the DGI E-Tax 2.0 / TU@PANAMA digital portal (www.dgi.gob.pa). The transfer pricing informative return (Formulario 300) and the ESR annual return are attached or filed separately on the same portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; advance installment payments apply to large taxpayers under the 2% minimum effective tax regime, but the statutory return itself is annual.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within three months after the fiscal year-end; for a December 31 year-end, the return is due in March of the following year, with the exact due date assigned by the last digit of the RUC (administrative calendar, typically March 15-31); no blanket extension is available except by formal DGI petition.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Panama taxpayer identification number of the S.A.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Panamanian RUC assigned at incorporation; include foreign beneficial owner identification in the beneficial ownership schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from anti-dumping and trade-remedy defense consulting services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Panama-source fees. Fees for defense work physically performed abroad and managed abroad are excluded from the territorial base; fees delivered from a Panamanian office to foreign clients are taxable in Panama.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions directly incurred to produce Panama-source income, supported by invoices and fiscal documentation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border fees paid to related non-resident advisors are deductible only if the 12.5% withholding tax (or treaty-reduced rate) is paid and economic substance is evidenced.
Recompute with strict territorial sourcing; disallow costs attributable to exempt foreign revenue; undocumented related-party payments may be recharacterized as dividends.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Dividend withholding tax declared and remitted by the S.A. on distributed profits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply 5% on dividends sourced from taxed profits and 10% on dividends sourced from untaxed or exempt profits; treaty reduction requires prior DGI authorization and a certified Tax Residency Certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total 2% advance installments and withholding tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits are not applicable because Panama excludes foreign-source income; include only Panamanian withholdings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 30 (Saldo a pagar o a favor)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax due after credits, or refundable balance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Settle by electronic transfer to the DGI collection account; refund claims trigger an audit of exempt-income classification.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: USD 10.00 per day per overdue return (Código Fiscal Article 738-A) and a fine of 5%-20% of the tax due; late payment: monthly surcharge of 1% (12% annual) plus statutory interest of 9% per annum; unfiled returns after notice are assessed ex officio with penalties of up to 100% of omitted tax and preventive embargo of bank accounts and assets.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 5% on dividends paid out of Panama-taxed profits; 10% on dividends paid out of untaxed or foreign-source profits (Código Fiscal, Articles 300-302). The S.A. must self-withhold and remit the applicable rate at each dividend decree; the 10% rate is the default for distributions of exempt or offshore profits of a standard consultancy holding S.A.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama applies its limited comprehensive DTA network (Netherlands, United Kingdom, Spain, Portugal, France, Mexico-not-in-force) through a certificate-based protocol: obtain the foreign shareholder's Tax Residency Certificate (TRC), apostille it, submit the TRC and the relevant DTA dividend article to the DGI International Taxation section for prior reduced-rate authorization or a certificate of non-withholding; the payer then applies the treaty rate on the withholding return and retains the complete file for five years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for trademarks, patents, technical assistance, and know-how paid to non-residents: 12.5% statutory withholding (Código Fiscal, Article 297); treaty rates generally 5%-10% (e.g., 5% under the Netherlands and UK DTAs). Interest paid to non-resident creditors: 12.5% statutory withholding; interest on export letters of credit and interbank financing is exempt; DTA rates commonly 5%-10%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory where gross annual revenue exceeds USD 2,500,000 (B/. 2,500,000), or where the taxpayer has related-party transactions with entities in a low-tax jurisdiction regardless of revenue; Master File mandatory where the multinational group's consolidated annual revenue equals or exceeds EUR 750,000,000 (approximately USD 800,000,000). The annual Transfer Pricing Informative Return (Formulario 300) is due with Form 202 within three months of fiscal year-end.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations (Law 70 of 2019, effective January 1, 2020) apply to tax-resident S.A.s generating income from relevant activities, including consultancy and trade defense services. The company must prove in its annual ESR return (filed via E-Tax 2.0) that it is managed and directed in Panama, maintains adequate local premises, employs adequate qualified local staff, and incurs adequate local operating expenditure; penalties range from USD 10,000 to USD 100,000 per year, with repeat non-compliance exposed to penalties of up to USD 1,000,000 and cancellation of ESR standing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally misstating the territorial source of anti-dumping fees, inflating deductible expenses, omitting Form 202, or distributing untaxed profits without the 10% dividend withholding.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of 2 to 5 times the evaded tax; aggravated surcharge of 50% where evasion exceeds B/. 300,000 (Law 38 of 2016); ex officio assessment and preventive embargo of assets; imprisonment of 2 to 5 years for evasion above B/. 300,000, extended to 5 to 10 years where false documents are used.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and resident agents who sign fraudulent returns are jointly and severally liable for corporate tax debt; exposure to civil restitution, asset seizure, travel bans, and imprisonment; professional licenses revoked.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the S.A. as a letterbox entity with no office, no local employees, no local management, and no ESR filing while treating Panama-source consulting revenue as exempt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR fines under Law 70 of 2019: USD 10,000-100,000 per year; repeated non-compliance up to USD 1,000,000; DGI recharacterization of income as taxable Panama-source at 25% plus surcharges; cancellation of the municipal Aviso de Operación.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil may be pierced by Panamanian courts where the S.A. is a mere instrumentality; directors personally liable for unpaid taxes, personal assets subject to seizure, and prohibition from serving as directors of any Panama corporation for up to 10 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain and file final beneficial owner information under Law 23 of 2015 and Decreto 345 de 2016, absence of KYC/CDD files, or accepting funds connected to sanctioned trade or money-laundering schemes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties up to USD 1,000,000 per violation; publication of sanctions in the Official Gazette; administrative dissolution and forced liquidation of the S.A.; cancellation of the resident agent's professional license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Criminal prosecution of directors and resident agents under Panamanian AML provisions with imprisonment of 5 to 12 years; civil restitution of laundered amounts; international banking restrictions and travel bans.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare and file Formulario 300 or the Local/Master File when the USD 2,500,000 threshold is exceeded, or engaging in unsupported related-party cross-border transactions with no arm's-length documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Mandatory penalty of 1% of the transaction value for each omitted related-party operation; intentional non-compliance exposed to penalties of up to 5% of total related-party amounts; DGI adjustment of the taxable base with 25% tax, 1% monthly surcharge, and 9% annual interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign the permissive declaration are personally liable for the resulting tax deficiency; deliberate TP default integrated with an evasion scheme triggers criminal fraud charges with imprisonment and civil restitution.
